newsitem.title: USA: UtiliCorp, Peco to launch company - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: UtiliCorp, Peco to launch company - WSJ.

text.p: Two electricity utilities, UtiliCorp United Inc and PECO Energy Co, are set to launch a new company with AT&T Corp offering consumers a one-stop shopping service for a variety of utilities, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Tuesday's electronic edition, the Journal said the company would allow consumers to buy their natural gas, electric, telephone, Internet and home-security services in one package.

The launch of the company, which has been named EnergyOne LLC, is to be announced later today in Washington. The companies hope it will be franchised to utilities across the United States as a way to expand market share in an era of deregulation.
At the same time, participating utilities would get the benefits of a national marketing campaign without the expense.
